**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or pricing-parity obligation in either direction. Targeted searches ("no less favourable", "favourable/favorable", "price", "customers", "third part") surfaced nothing relevant, and the candidate sections confirm this:

- **§11 Fees (p0084)** — a bare obligation to pay per the Fee Schedule; no parity or price-matching commitment.
- **§10 Maintenance and Support (p0065–p0082)** — Garman-side service obligations plus limited chargeable-repair carve-outs; no fee-parity or benchmarking language.
- **§20 General Matters (p0141–p0147)** — standard boilerplate (waiver, assignment, independent contractors, force majeure, severability, governing law); no MFN.

Since nothing requires Sparkling to offer Garman terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers, the preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer) is satisfied. An MFN in our favour would be welcome but is an optional ask only, so no redline was raised.
